shared_elements: pale tan/buff stone surface with carved decoration
row of small repeated motifs forming a band across the upper area
division of the surface into an upper band and a larger figural field
quadruped/animal or standing anthropomorphic figures in low relief
justification: Both are tan stone panels organised with a band of small repeated motifs across the top and a larger field of profile figures below, and both include a disc and an arm raised in gesture. But A is boldly modelled, deep relief dominated by animals on a thick three-dimensional pillar photographed in situ, whereas B is a thin, flat-topped plaque with fine, shallow incised lines depicting slender human figures and dense sign-like marks — the carving technique, subject and format differ sharply.
